name: Machine Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit beneath an independent-arm pulldown machine and secure the thigh pads over your legs.
Take one overhead handle, rest your free hand on the frame and sit tall as your working arm extends.
Drive your working elbow downward toward your ribs to pull the handle smoothly down beside your shoulder.
Control the handle slowly back overhead to full extension, and switch arms after finishing one side.
tips: Avoid leaning heavily sideways toward the working side to yank the handle down.
Focus on depressing your shoulder blade as you initiate each pull.
